user_prompt: Use $modal-sandbox to run separate jobs while keeping generated files in one remote workspace.

preview_commands: sandbox --workspace-volume work preview write app.py --content-file app.py

recovery_guidance.remote_nonzero: Report the failed command before attempting verification.
recovery_guidance.truncated_output: Use read or download for the intended artifact instead of inferring its content.
recovery_guidance.cleanup_failure: Keep the named volume unless the user separately authorizes deleting persistent data.

plugin_plan.resource_boundary: Live Modal commands and destructive cleanup require explicit user approval.
